answer:
ExxonMobil (XOM) has received mixed analyst ratings recently. As of October 6th, JP Morgan maintained its "Buy" rating with a price target of $85.00, while Morgan Stanley downgraded to "Hold" with a lower price target of $79.50 [Source: ratings-xom-001]. Piper Sandler also maintains an "Overweight" rating but has increased the price target from $130.00 to $135.00, citing progress in Pioneer integration and structural cost advantages [Source: rating-xom-002].

Regarding recent financial news, ExxonMobil reported Q3 earnings that exceeded expectations on October 4th, with oil prices surging and strong demand noted by the company on October 5th [Sources: Reuters articles - "ExxonMobil Reports Q3 Earnings Beat Expectations" (2023-10-04) and "Oil Prices Surge, ExxonMobil Sees Strong Demand" (2023-10-05
